enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Quality Reflex Save +3: This item gives a +3 Quality bonus to your Reflex saves.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Physical Sheltering +37: +37 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
